notes: ACCESS: IPv4 egress was live this session, so plain curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome' reached wayfair.com directly on every request (HTTP 200, no PerimeterX challenge); the IPv6 Cloudflare-edge CURLOPT_RESOLVE pin and translate.goog fallbacks recorded in the prior Home-Decor pass were not needed. robots.txt was checked first: it has a single 'User-agent: *' group and names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent, and the 'Allow: /*/sb0/' rule explicitly permits the listing URLs used here. TREE: built from Wayfair's own category-tile hubs, walked top-down from the Furniture department hub /furniture/cat/furniture-c45974.html and cross-checked against the Department Navigation mega-menu in the page source and the seo-category-sitemap~0.xml category sitemap (893 /cat/ hubs, 56 of them under /furniture/). Every /cat/ hub whose children could be furniture was opened and its child tiles read: Living Room, Chairs & Seating, Coffee Tables & End Tables, TV Stands & Media Storage, Media Storage & Accessories, Futons & Daybeds, Bedroom, Beds & Headboards, Kitchen & Dining, Dining Tables & Seating, Bar Furniture, Bar Stools & Counter Stools, Office, Entry & Mudroom, Shoe Storage, Storage Furniture, Bathroom Furniture, Bathroom Vanities, Custom Furniture, Game Tables & Game Room, Baby & Kids Furniture, Nursery, Toddler & Kids Bedroom, Teen Bedroom, Playroom, Outdoor & Patio Furniture, Patio Furniture Sets, Outdoor Seating & Patio Chairs, Patio Seating, Outdoor Tables, Patio Bar Furniture. Only the deepest node with its own /sb0/ listing grid was recorded as a leaf; every /cat/ hub that had extractable children became a grouping row. QTY: each leaf's number is the listing grid's own total from the Next.js RSC payload, BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount.data.resultCount - the exact value Wayfair renders as the 'N Results' header above the grid. For all 168 leaves it was confirmed twice more in the same payload by BlockBuilderBrowsePagination.numberOfItems and by pageTrackingMetadata.totalSKUCount whose categoryId equals the c-number in the URL (0 cross-check failures). SANITY: the number varies per category, so it is not a site-wide total; no value is a suspiciously round display cap; every page's h1 matched the category requested (no silent parent-serving); a 10-leaf second read later in the session reproduced 9 counts exactly and showed Cube Storage moving 624 -> 625 (flagged). EXCLUDED and why: all 'Sale' / 'All ...' / 'Shop all' / 'Small Space ...' / 'Patio Furniture by Material' nodes (navigation, filter and marketing pages per the brief); mattresses, foundations, box springs, futon mattresses, crib mattresses and adjustable bed bases (bedding, not furniture); slipcovers, TV/speaker/projector mounts and accessories, office chair accessories, chair mats, vanity tops, conversion rails and changing-table pads (parts, covers and fixtures); wall hooks, coat/blanket ladders' racks, umbrella stands, safes, storage trunks, storage boxes, bins, cube/closet organisers and over-the-door organisers (standalone storage goods, reserved for the Storage task); fireplaces and stoves, kegerators, wine refrigerators, wine racks, kitchen mats, bed canopies, baby gates, play mats, nap mats, easels, arcade games, dartboards, board games, sports cases and life-size cutouts (not furniture); the Pet department; outdoor umbrellas, shades, gazebos, pergolas, canopies, awnings, outdoor cushions and outdoor decor. Cross-department nodes that Wayfair itself files under a furniture hub were kept at their furniture parent (Storage Benches, Shoe Storage, Bathroom Cabinets & Shelving, Medicine Cabinets, Bathroom Vanities, Craft & Sewing Tables, Food Pantries, Cube Storage, Storage Ottomans). Nodes appearing under two hubs (Sofas, Sectionals, Loveseats, Bookcases, Cabinets & Chests, Console Tables, Bean Bag Chairs, Theater Seating, Gaming Chairs/Desks, Coat Racks, Baby & Kids Dressers/Bookcases, Daybeds, Patio Conversation Sets, Patio Bar Tables) were emitted exactly once, under their most natural parent, so no link repeats.
